title: Cache Conformance Law
description: ⚖️ A task is shared through the fleet cache only when a hit gives the same result as running it: it declares every file it writes (outputs complete and restorable), declares what it reads (inputs expand without anything uninterpreted, a gitignored input is covered by a runtime digest), carries no absolute path or machine identity in its outputs, inputs or command, and does not depend on the machine. A task that cannot satisfy this is uncacheable with a stated reason, or guarded (local cache only) until its fix lands. States: `shared`, `guarded`, `uncacheable` (with the policy's physical reason) and `violation` (cacheable although the law finds a defect: a defect fails the conformance test).
